C0742.title: NetEase Games Internal Anti-Corruption Storm: Multiple Executives Investigated for Graft
C0742.summary: Around November 7 to 8, 2024, multiple NetEase Games personnel were investigated over suspected corruption. Reports said marketing-related personnel accounted for a large share and the amount involved might reach over 100 million yuan, although the exact amount had not been officially confirmed. NetEase later reported that multiple people had been criminally filed against and subjected to criminal coercive measures, and 27 companies were placed on a permanent no-cooperation list, reflecting continued pressure against accepting supplier bribes through positions of authority.
